user.title: Link a paired reader
user.description: Pair the reader in Zigbee2MQTT first and wait for its interview to finish. Enter the base topic to list real readers.

reader.title: Choose the paired reader
reader.description: Select a physical reader by its IEEE Zigbee address. Names and UIDs are stored independently for each reader.

workspace.title: Enable the ZigRed workspace
workspace.description: Enable the sidebar page for USB flashing and converter installation before pairing a reader. This step creates no physical reader. Pair a real reader in Zigbee2MQTT, then use Add reader in the panel.

error.invalid_topic: Enter an exact base topic without + or #.
error.no_readers: No paired and interviewed ZigRed found. Pair it in Zigbee2MQTT first, then retry.
error.bridge_unavailable: Device inventory unavailable. Check MQTT, base topic and Zigbee2MQTT.

abort.reader_removed: This reader is no longer paired. Search again.
abort.bridge_unavailable: Zigbee2MQTT did not respond. Search again.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Linked to the selected reader. Saved names and UIDs were preserved.
abort.workspace_no_reconfigure: Open ZigRed in the sidebar to manage the workspace. Use Add reader to link a device.
